existingEnglish: And the Lord God formed from the earth every beast of the field and every fowl of the heavens, and He brought [it] to man to see what he would call it, and whatever the man called each living thing, that was its name.

- "formed" → "fashioned" (יִּצֶר can mean formed/fashioned)

- "fowl" → "bird" (עוֹף = bird/fowl)

verse-20:

verse-23:
Hebrew: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֘ הָֽאָדָם֒ זֹ֣את הַפַּ֗עַם עֶ֚צֶם מֵֽעֲצָמַ֔י וּבָשָׂ֖ר מִבְּשָׂרִ֑י לְזֹאת֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י מֵאִ֖ישׁ לֻֽקֳחָה־זֹּֽאת:
existingEnglish: And man said, "This time, it is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. This one shall be called ishah (woman) because this one was taken from ish (man)."

verse-24:

existingEnglish: Therefore, a man shall leave his father and his mother, and cleave to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.

Refinement:

- "his father and his mother" → "his father and his mother"

translations.english: And Awtsmoos Elokim fashioned from the ground every beast of the field and every bird of the sky, and He brought them to the man to see what he would call it, and whatever the man called it, that was its name.
And the man called names to all the livestock and to the birds of the sky and to every beast of the field, but for the man, he did not find a helper corresponding to him.
And Awtsmoos Elokim cast a deep sleep upon the man, and he slept, and He took one of his ribs, and He closed up the flesh in its place.
And Awtsmoos Elokim fashioned the rib that He had taken from the man into a woman, and He brought her to the man.
And the man said, "This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. This one shall be called woman, for she was taken from man."
Therefore, a man shall leave his father and his mother, and shall cling to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.
